ranked.headline: Encoding biological knowledge into compact sequence models for genomic and protein tasks
ranked.summary: Alignment-free k-mer, taxonomy-guided, and structure-aware representations offer compact alternatives to alignment-based sequence analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: Computational methods link variant effects to gene-level and trait-level inference
ranked.summary: Variant-level evidence is being converted into gene-level and trait-level inference, with calibration and ancestry performance now assessed directly.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer spatial tissue organization from spatial transcriptomics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend spatial marker detection, domain discovery, slice alignment, and cell-trait mapping to imaging and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and peptide representations drive binding prediction and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test protein language model embeddings directly against binding, viability and design tasks.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict biomolecular evolution, dynamics and variant effects
ranked.summary: Zero-shot sequence models predict additive mutations well but fail under strong epistasis, constraining variant-effect prediction claims.

ranked.headline: Long-read and hybrid inputs extend variant calling beyond short-read alignment
ranked.summary: Long-read, hybrid, and donor-specific inputs are improving variant detection accuracy across small, somatic, and pooled-sequencing applications.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning models validated against biological and clinical readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark transfer learning and multimodal foundation models against downstream tasks, survival outcomes, and missing-data robustness.

ranked.headline: Structure-encoded inference of tumor states from single-cell, spatial, and plasma data
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial, and cell-free plasma measurements are now paired with inference models that encode network, spatial, or cell-state context.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for sequence-based protein, splicing, and small RNA analysis
ranked.summary: Sequence-based models and pipelines now address splicing, mitochondrial proteomes, and PIWI cleavage with explicit evolutionary or regulatory context.

ranked.headline: Ligand input format and charge alter co-folding predictions of protein-ligand complexes
ranked.summary: Predictors are now being stress-tested on input representation, charge, quantum descriptors, and public training data.

ranked.headline: Experimental and reference data are coupling into protein structural modeling pipelines
ranked.summary: Explicit coupling of heterogeneous data sources to modeling pipelines is the common thread across these four recent items.

ranked.headline: Multimodal embeddings and graph models score drug and target interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple heterogeneous molecular features with graph and factorization models for drug-target and synergy prediction.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks for peak, expression and methylation data across omics layers
ranked.summary: Recent tools target inference error in peak calling, differential expression and methylation imputation before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide STRs and SNP-similarity methods refine population structure and phasing
ranked.summary: Methods now infer population structure and chromosome-scale phasing from unrelated samples using STRs, SNP similarity, and pangenome assemblies.

ranked.headline: Learned models map cryo-EM and cryo-ET density to molecular structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply variational, regression, and diffusion models directly to cryo-EM and cryo-ET density data.

ranked.headline: Intrinsic noise and protease competition shape oscillations and patterns in gene networks
ranked.summary: Scalable second-moment and reaction-time analyses now address how noise and competition alter regulatory dynamics beyond classical kinetics.

ranked.headline: Raw-read pipelines infer resistance determinants and pathogen hosts without assembly
ranked.summary: Packaging resistance and pathogen inference from raw sequencing reads as end-to-end tools is now appearing across preprints and one publication.

ranked.headline: Ancestry and environment shape immune eQTLs; simulators add HLA restriction
ranked.summary: Population-scale immune profiling and HLA-aware simulators now encode host immune variation explicitly in both data and models.

ranked.headline: Directed, scale-dependent and information-theoretic measures of brain network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work applies sliding-window, coarse-graining, and information-decomposition methods to MEG, fMRI, LFP, and representational drift data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking EEG, MEG and TMS Methods for Neural Machine Learning
ranked.summary: Expert-annotated clinical neural datasets and foundation-model tokenization now set the constraints for machine learning on brain recordings.

ranked.headline: Software converts microscopy images into quantitative measurements across scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications present automated image analysis tools spanning tissue, cellular, subcellular, and molecular scales.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks question whether single-cell foundation models capture regulatory mechanism
ranked.summary: Recent evaluations test whether single-cell predictive models scale, forecast perturbation responses, and encode interpretable regulatory signal.

ranked.headline: Generative and predictive models benchmarked for protein structure and dynamics
ranked.summary: Experimental and physics-based references now test whether learned models recover conformational dynamics and binding-site structure.

ranked.headline: Simulations link mechanics of nucleosomes, capsids and membranes to function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply coarse-grained and molecular dynamics simulations to nucleosomes, membranes, and viral capsids.

ranked.headline: Causal genetics and metabolic models nominate liver and aging disease targets
ranked.summary: Inference on existing multi-omic and transcriptomic data is moving toward causal and constraint-based target prioritization across aging and metabolic disease.

ranked.headline: New tools and benchmarks sharpen transcript-level RNA analysis across read types
ranked.summary: Bulk, long-read, and small-RNA methods now resolve splicing, isoforms, and tRNA modifications with benchmarked, scalable computational workflows.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genomes of three human Plasmodium species from natural infections
ranked.summary: Genome-scale resources for parasites and pathogens now come from natural infection samples and multi-strain comparisons, extending annotation coverage.

ranked.headline: Evaluation splits are being redesigned to expose shortcuts in biomolecular ML models
ranked.summary: Preprints show benchmark splits can reward shortcuts in biomolecular prediction, motivating stratified and entity-balanced evaluation.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines quantify single-molecule states in imaging and nanopore data
ranked.summary: Super-resolution, live-cell tracking and nanopore sensing now yield single-molecule measurements that demand uncertainty-aware, reproducible analysis.

ranked.headline: Explicit error models and learned components reshape MS proteomics data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools model acquisition and error explicitly to scale DIA, peptide retention, and abundance analysis.

ranked.headline: Reusable software tools for alignment, regulatory-motif and knockout-phenotype analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool pair specialised analysis methods with scriptable or interactive output for genomics and regulatory biology.

ranked.headline: Inferring pathogen resistance and variant abundance from indirect or mixed data
ranked.summary: Non-sequencing proxies and population-level abundance models are extending pathogen variant inference beyond conventional isolate-level WGS.

ranked.headline: Model-based inference of host, gene, and community traits from metagenomic reads
ranked.summary: Explicit likelihood and metabolic models now extract host sex, gene bimodality, and probiotic engraftment from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Gene model curation and comparative annotation refine genomes across animals and algae
ranked.summary: Newly released curated annotations and orthology for 301 Drosophilidae species, alongside Australian kelp assemblies, sharpen cross-lineage comparisons.

ranked.headline: Selective compression and hashing cut the cost of long genomic sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Long-context DNA modeling, pangenome alignment, and streaming k-mer workloads each require controlling how much sequence data is retained.

ranked.headline: Agentic LLM pipelines build auditable, provenance-traced biomedical knowledge graphs
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous biomedical resources are now being converted into structured, provenance-linked claims with explicit audit or consensus gating.

ranked.headline: Faster exact and remote homology search tools for sequences and structures
ranked.summary: Four recent tools address scale and sensitivity limits in sequence search, alignment, and phylogenetic placement across large databases and reference trees.

ranked.headline: Post-mortem artifacts and cell-state complexity shape human transcriptomic profiles
ranked.summary: Single-cell and RNA-seq studies now expose low-complexity cell states and post-mortem artifacts that confound human tissue transcriptomic interpretation.

ranked.headline: Typing somatic mutations by regulatory, driver, repair and contextual impact
ranked.summary: Cohorts of 560 breast cancer genomes and over 210,000 patients now allow somatic mutation effects to be inferred at regulatory, driver and repair levels.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models link imaging, metabolite and network data to biological traits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply learned and network models to echocardiography, brain MRI, metabolomics and long COVID data.
